sections.title: About Gaoteng Energy
sections.text: Your solar + storage supplier and system integrator for home and commercial projects.

Gaoteng Energy is a supplier and integrator of solar and energy-storage systems. We are not a factory: we partner with a vetted network of certified manufacturers to source inverters, LiFePO4 batteries, solar panels and balance-of-system parts, then design them into complete systems that fit your project.

Our focus is home energy storage and commercial & industrial (C&I) energy storage — for families who want backup power, and businesses that want lower energy costs and resilience.

sections.title: One-Stop Sourcing, Neutrally Selected
sections.body:
Because we are not tied to a single factory, we can choose components on fit — not on what we happen to make. We qualify each supplier for certifications, production consistency and after-sales, then bundle everything into one shipment with unified documentation.

The result: a wider choice, clearer accountability, and a single point of contact from quotation to commissioning.

sections.text:
A single-brand seller can only offer what they make. As an integrator, we assemble the best-fit parts for your case, keep one warranty window, and speak your language — English, and French for West Africa.

For African and Indian projects we pay special attention to high-temperature performance, dust resistance and local serviceability, because that is where systems live or fail.
